   237→  getPosts(options: GetPostsOptions): Post[]

   240→export function createDb(dbPath: string): Database {
   241→  const db = new BetterSqlite3(dbPath)
   242→  db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL')
   243→
   244→  // Create tables — never joined
   245→  db.exec(`
   246→    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS identities (
   247→      agentName TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
   248→      encryptedIdentity TEXT NOT NULL,
   249→      identityCommitment TEXT NOT NULL,
   250→      createdAt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
   251→    )
   252→  `)
   253→
   254→  db.exec(`
   255→    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (
   256→      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
   257→      title TEXT NOT NULL,
   258→      content TEXT NOT NULL,
   259→      tier TEXT NOT NULL,
   260→      timestamp TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
   261→      proofHash TEXT NOT NULL,
   262→      publicSignals TEXT NOT NULL,
   263→      proof TEXT NOT NULL
   264→    )
   265→  `)
   266→
   267→  const insertIdentity = db.prepare(
   268→    'INSERT INTO identities (agentName, encryptedIdentity, identityCommitment) VALUES (?, ?, ?)'
   269→  )
   270→
   271→  const selectIdentity = db.prepare(
   272→    'SELECT * FROM identities WHERE agentName = ?'
   273→  )
   274→
   275→  const insertPost = db.prepare(
   276→    'INSERT INTO posts (title, content, tier, proofHash, publicSignals, proof) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
   277→  )
   278→
   279→  return {
   280→    saveIdentity(agentName, encryptedIdentity, identityCommitment) {
   281→      insertIdentity.run(agentName, encryptedIdentity, identityCommitment)
   282→    },
   283→
   284→    getIdentity(agentName) {
   285→      return (selectIdentity.get(agentName) as Identity) ?? null
   286→    },
   287→
   288→    savePost(post) {
   289→      const result = insertPost.run(
   290→        post.title, post.content, post.tier,
   291→        post.proofHash, post.publicSignals, post.proof
   292→      )
   293→      return Number(result.lastInsertRowid)
   294→    },
   295→
   296→    getPosts({ limit, cursor, tier }) {
   297→      let sql = 'SELECT * FROM posts'
   298→      const params: any[] = []
   299→      const conditions: string[] = []
   300→
   301→      if (cursor) {
   302→        conditions.push('id < ?')
   303→        params.push(cursor)
   304→      }
   305→      if (tier) {
   306→        conditions.push('tier = ?')
   307→        params.push(tier)
   308→      }
   309→      if (conditions.length) {
   310→        sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ')
   311→      }
   312→      sql += ' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?'
   313→      params.push(limit)

    31→// --- Auto User State Transition ---
    32→// UniRep requires a state transition when a new epoch starts before
    33→// reputation from previous epochs can be used. This helper checks and
    34→// performs the transition transparently so agents never think about epochs.
    35→async function ensureStateTransition(userState: UserState): Promise<void> {
    36→  const currentEpoch = await userState.latestTransitionedEpoch()
    37→  const onChainEpoch = await userState.sync.loadCurrentEpoch()
    38→  if (currentEpoch < onChainEpoch) {
    39→    const { publicSignals, proof } = await userState.genUserStateTransitionProof()
    40→    const provider = new ethers.providers.JsonRpcProvider(config.provider)
    41→    const wallet = new ethers.Wallet(config.privateKey, provider)
    42→    const unirep = new ethers.Contract(
    43→      config.unirepAddress,
    44→      ['function userStateTransition(uint256[] memory publicSignals, uint256[8] memory proof) public'],
    45→      wallet
    46→    )
    47→    const tx = await unirep.userStateTransition(publicSignals, proof)
    48→    await tx.wait()
    49→    await userState.waitForSync()
    50→  }
    51→}

    53→// Simple AES-256-GCM encryption for identity storage
    54→export function encryptIdentity(identitySecret: string, key: string): string {
    55→  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(16)
    56→  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(
    57→    'aes-256-gcm',
    58→    crypto.createHash('sha256').update(key).digest(),
    59→    iv
    60→  )
    61→  let encrypted = cipher.update(identitySecret, 'utf8', 'hex')
    62→  encrypted += cipher.final('hex')
    63→  const tag = cipher.getAuthTag().toString('hex')
    64→  return `${iv.toString('hex')}:${tag}:${encrypted}`
    65→}
    66→
    67→export function decryptIdentity(encrypted: string, key: string): string {
    68→  const [ivHex, tagHex, data] = encrypted.split(':')
    69→  const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(
    70→    'aes-256-gcm',
    71→    crypto.createHash('sha256').update(key).digest(),
    72→    Buffer.from(ivHex, 'hex')
    73→  )
    74→  decipher.setAuthTag(Buffer.from(tagHex, 'hex'))
    75→  let decrypted = decipher.update(data, 'hex', 'utf8')
    76→  decrypted += decipher.final('utf8')
    77→  return decrypted
    78→}

   456→          error: `Invalid tier. Must be one of: newcomer, contributor, trusted, legend`,

   481→        const { publicSignals, proof } = await userState.genProveReputationProof({
   482→          minRep: threshold,
   483→        })
   484→

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { Box, Text, useApp, useInput } from 'ink'
import { PostCard } from './PostCard'
import { StatusBar } from './StatusBar'

interface Post {
  id: number
  title: string
  content: string
  tier: string
  timestamp: string
  proofHash: string
}

export function App({ relayUrl }: { relayUrl: string }) {
  const { exit } = useApp()
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState<Post[]>([])
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Keyboard controls

      case 'q': exit(); break
      case 'a': setFilter('all'); break
      case 'l': setFilter('legend'); break
      case 't': setFilter('trusted'); break
      case 'c': setFilter('contributor'); break
      case 'n': setFilter('newcomer'); break
    }
  })

  // Poll for posts
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchPosts = async () => {
      try {
        const tierParam = filter !== 'all' ? `&tier=${filter}` : ''
        const res = await fetch(`${relayUrl}/api/posts?limit=20${tierParam}`)
        const data = await res.json()
        if (data.success) {
          setPosts(data.posts)
          setError(null)
        }
      } catch (err) {
        setError(`Cannot reach relay at ${relayUrl}`)
      }
    }

    fetchPosts()
    const interval = setInterval(fetchPosts, 3000)
    return () => clearInterval(interval)
  }, [relayUrl, filter])

      )}

      {posts.map((post) => (
        <PostCard key={post.id} post={post} />
      ))}

      <StatusBar filter={filter} postCount={posts.length} />
    </Box>
  )
}
```
